items.title: How Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk made the case for AI at the G20 meeting
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Fed Correspondent Jennifer Schonberger joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to report on Meta (META) CEO Mark Zuckerberg and SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk speaking on the projected benefits of AI, including job growth and boosting the global economy by 20 to 30%, at the G20 Innovation Ministerial in Chapel Hill, N.C.

items.title: Can Hedging and Long-Term PPAs Strengthen Vistra's Growth?
items.summary: VST's heavy hedging and 20-year nuclear PPAs with AWS and Meta aim to lock in revenues, steady cash flow and support long-term growth.

items.title: Sundar Pichai’s Credibility Crisis: The AI Model That Never Came
items.summary: Sundar Pichai promised a flagship AI model in June, prediction markets already declared it dead by August, and Google just shipped something else entirely. What that substitution reveals about DeepMind's internal chaos and Alphabet's cloud ambitions is the story investors are missing.

items.title: Marvell vs. Broadcom: One AI Stock Looks More Attractive Right Now
items.summary: Marvell and Broadcom both rode the AI wave to blowout quarters, but the businesses behind the tickers are built on completely different gambles, and only one of them offers a cushion if a major hyperscaler changes course.

items.title: MANGOS ETFs: The Next Big AI Tech Investing Theme
items.summary: MANGOS is emerging as the next AI-focused tech basket, with several ETFs filed to capture the group's potential growth.

items.title: 4 Stocks to Buy Now to Ride the AI Data Center Spending Boom
items.summary: NVIDIA, Micron, SanDisk and Lam Research offer four ways to ride the AI data center boom across chips, memory, storage and equipment.

items.title: Apple’s New CEO Has 8 Days to Answer the AI Question That Could Redefine Computing
items.summary: John Ternus steps into the CEO role at Apple with the stock near a record high, but the hardware event eight days away demands something far harder than a good quarter: a convincing answer to why the iPhone stays at the center of computing when AI agents start replacing the apps on it.

items.title: Meta $18 billion settlement cost pressure AI product pipeline
